image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — The AI that lives on your screen
image:image.image:caption: The AI that lives on your screen. Say “Hey Nova” and it sees your screen, talks back and does the clicking. Free for Windows 10 and 11.

image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — Say Hey Nova
image:image.image:caption: HEY NOVA in large letters with Izuki's liquid orb as the O. Then just talk; it answers out loud and gets it done.

image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — Hey Nova, wake up.
image:image.image:caption: The wake-up status screen, a clock inside glowing rings with voice online, screen linked and apps connected.

image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — It explains. You answer.
image:image.image:caption: A quiz question on screen with floating answers and Izuki coaching, never picking the answer for you.

image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — Your PC, from your phone
image:image.image:caption: A phone on a call with Izuki's orb, saying you have two new emails. Works on Android, iPhone and any browser.

image:image.image:title: Izuki Nova (Nova Izuki) — Twelve brains. Your pick.
image:image.image:caption: Twelve AI providers to choose from, including Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Groq, NVIDIA and Ollama offline.
